title: Not Eligible | EU 261 (EU Mainland) | No Travel Origin | MSL Delay Below 3 Hours | Cancellation | Single Pax | 1 Leg
description:
EU Mainland flight (CDG?YYZ, AC-operated) cancelled due to controllable reason (cancellation code CREW), but the re-routing delay to next available flight was only 2 hours � below the 3-hour EU 261 threshold (Gate 8). Despite controllable cause and cancellation, insufficient delay = NOT ELIGIBLE. Validates: (1) EU 261 3-hour threshold applies to No Travel Origin scenarios, (2) Threshold overrides controllability � even with CREW (controllable) cancellation code, delay below 3h = NE, (3) Cancellation code CREW correctly classified as Controllable but threshold still blocks eligibility.

Prerequisites:
PNR: single passenger Arnaud Picard (Adult). Journey: 1 leg AC operated, Flight AC 871, CDG?YYZ. Flight status: CANCELLED. Cancellation code: CREW (Crew unavailability � Controllable). Original scheduled arrival: 13:00. Next available rebooking arrival: 15:00 (2hr delay � below 3hr threshold). Customer action: Stayed at CDG, did NOT accept rebooking, did NOT travel. No Travel status: Origin. Fallback: FALSE (cancellation code available). Regime: EU 261 (EU Mainland � CDG origin). Result: NOT ELIGIBLE (delay below 3hr threshold despite controllable cause).
